prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. The solid world is turning liquid: the mountain of rubber-banded money runs slowly downhill like warm honey, the brick vault walls sag and drip like candle wax, and the gold chain drips gold drops. Everything else is a realistic photograph. A tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache lies back on top of the money, eyes half closed and glazed, a banknote resting on his chest. Camera low at the foot of the pile, dripping notes in the foreground. Light: one hanging brass lamp above, warm amber on the money; the vault behind falls to deep green shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
